Name: Dust Sprites in the Coop by Wickedy - BFAV
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[size=5][b][u]About[/u][/b][/size]

If you know me, then you know that I am OBSESSED with dust sprites. They are probably my favorite little monster and I've always wanted more of an option to raise them. Well, now you can too!

Marnie now sells dust sprites (with [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-68#post-47274]BFAV 3.0.0+ unofficial version[/url]) that you can keep in your coop. Any size coop will do!

These little dusties aren't as aggressive as the ones you may find in the wild and in the mines. Tame dust sprites are pretty chill, off the coffee and pretty happy, so you won't see them aggressively bouncing towards you in attack mode. These ones are such happy little sprites that you can often hear their happy little dust sprite squeaks as you go about your day on the farm.

Baby dust sprites take 3 days to mature, and when they do, they will give you little gifts. First, there is coal, but as you build up friendships with them, they will start to gift you a new item: Coal Lumps.
[center]﻿[/center]They say if you get a lump of coal from Santa you've been bad that year, but it's quite the opposite here. Coal Lumps are so great, that they even come gift-wrapped in a little red bow! (Santa likely also has a dust sprite farm in the north pole.) 

Coal Lumps are a little special, as in you need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url] to really get the most out of it. Put a lump of coal into the charcoal kiln and in 2 hours, you'll receive up to 15 coal per each.

This mod is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate
[/url]
[size=5][u][b]Installation[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods and their dependencies:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets
﻿[/url]- [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-68#post-47274]Better Farm Animal Variety aka BFAV[/url] (unofficial update)[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate[/url] (optional)[/size]
